biggest_catch: The playtester onboarding is unpaid, and playtest invitations depend on your profile and developer demand, so tests are not guaranteed daily.
catches: Playtest invitations depend on your profile and developer demand - tests are sporadic.
Recording for longer than the required time does not increase the reward.
PayPal redemptions through Tremendous carry a 6% processing fee per PlaytestCloud's official FAQ.

c1.evidence: Official tester FAQ: 'Generally, a 15 minute playtest and survey will have a reward of $5-9 USD.'

c2.evidence: Official: 'you can expect to receive the payment in up to 3 days' after completing a playtest study well, with no payout threshold.

c3.evidence: Official: 'We will never ask you to pay a subscription or anything like that to become a playtester.'

c4.evidence: $5-$9 per 15-minute playtest; paid within 3 days per playtest - all official.

eligibility: Sign up and pass the unpaid Playtester Onboarding; invitations depend on your profile and developer demand.
maximize: Complete the unpaid Playtester Onboarding first. Fill out the 'Reward payment information' section in your profile, since a complete profile improves your chances of getting playtests. For every paid playtest: record somewhere quiet with no background noise, talk out loud through the whole recording, complete all in-game tasks, and complete the survey after the session with detailed answers. Do not record longer than required - it does not raise the reward.

steps: Sign up on PlaytestCloud and complete the unpaid Playtester Onboarding.
Fill out the Reward payment information in your profile.
Accept playtest invitations from the email they send you.
Play for the required time while talking out loud, then complete the survey.
Receive the payment within up to 3 days.
timing: Paid within up to 3 days after completing a playtest study well; no payout threshold.
